name: Lookahead Assist
description: Delays your clicks to the last surviving frame. Cube, ball, spider, wave and orb support, with skill presets.

assist-on.name: Enable Assist
assist-on.description: Turns the click-delay assist on or off.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Picking a preset sets the two sliders below.

accuracy.name: Click Accuracy
accuracy.description: 0 = clicks fire as early as safely possible. 100 = clicks are delayed to the last frame that still survives.

lookahead.name: Lookahead Frames
lookahead.description: How many frames (at 60 FPS) ahead the assist looks for hazards.
